description: This file defines validation primitives and error handling for protocol message validation in the Playwright project, including validators for basic types, arrays, objects, and utility functions for schema management.

classes.name: ValidationError
classes.description: Custom error class for validation errors.

methods.name: findValidator
methods.description: Retrieves a validator for a specific type, method, and kind, throws if not found.

methods.name: maybeFindValidator
methods.description: Attempts to find a validator for a specific type, method, and kind, returns undefined if not found.

methods.name: createMetadataValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator for optional Metadata schema.

methods.name: tBinary
methods.description: Validator for binary data, handling base64 encoding/decoding based on context.

methods.name: tOptional
methods.description: Wraps a validator to make it optional.

methods.name: tArray
methods.description: Validator for arrays of a specific type.

methods.name: tObject
methods.description: Validator for objects with specified properties.

methods.name: tChannel
methods.description: Validator for channel names, uses context to validate.

methods.name: tType
methods.description: Validator that references a named schema in the scheme registry.
